title: Temple services
summary: Priests can now heal, lift curses and raise the dead for a price, ordered in conversation and recorded on a receipt.
items: The DM sets up a temple at a shop with ready-made prices from the free D&D rules (SRD 5.2.1 or SRD 5.1) or their own, and chooses which offers players can see.
Talk to the priest and choose Services · Temple: pick the spell, who it's for and whether you bring the diamond or the temple supplies it.
Most spells are paid and recorded at once. Raise Dead and Resurrection go to the DM first and are charged only if the DM approves; withdrawing or a refusal costs nothing.
You can pay for another party character who is with you.
Bigger spells need a bigger settlement: levels 3–5 need a town or city, levels 6–9 a city.
Services are recorded only: the DM updates hit points, conditions and the rest on the sheet.
Temples show up on the map's Here list and on the shop's place card.
